Title: Data and price changes in 10 Gbps ExpressRoute Exchange Provider

Body.Content: Effective immediately, we’ve changed the amount of egress data included in the 10 Gbps ExpressRoute Exchange Provider and reduced the price of 10 Gbps connections. The 10 Gbps ExpressRoute Exchange Provider dual-port circuit for data transfer out now includes 90 TB of egress in Zone 1 or 45 TB of egress in Zone 2. Data use that exceeds the included amount will be charged at existing rates. For more information, please visit the ExpressRoute page. For a comprehensive look at pricing, please visit the ExpressRoute Pricing page.
